Uses success chances and fees from the verified game source. Coins and shards are spent on success and failure. Unprotected failures reset to +0; protected failures lose one level and spend one scroll. Materials and scrolls are plentiful. Colossus cores are excluded.
强化技能等级在计算期间固定。真实强化成败均获得经验，可能升级并改变成功率，本版不模拟此过程。耗时按每次 2.4 秒计算，不含操作等待；不会执行游戏强化。

Enhancing skill level stays fixed. Actual attempts grant XP on success and failure and may raise your level and chances; this process is not simulated. Each attempt takes 2.4 seconds, excluding UI waiting. No game enhancements are executed.

dynamic.english: Timber props hold the shaft: every log shores it deeper, and you mine the faster for it.
dynamic.chinese: 木柱撑起矿道：每根原木都让它挖得更深，你的采矿也就更快。

dynamic.english: Millstones and blades of ore: the sharper the mill, the quicker the felling.
dynamic.chinese: 石磨配上矿石打的锯片：锯子越利，伐木越快。

dynamic.english: A stone basin, deepened rock by rock: the fuller the pond, the faster the catch.
dynamic.chinese: 一块块石头垒深的石池：池水越满，上钩越快。

dynamic.english: Fish dug into the beds as feed: the richer the soil, the faster the fields.
dynamic.chinese: 把鱼埋进苗床当肥料：土越肥，田里长得越快。

dynamic.english: Leather bellows breathe the fire -- the more hide worked into them, the hotter the hearth and the quicker the bar. A fighter brings the hides home.
dynamic.chinese: 皮革风箱为炉火鼓风——用的兽皮越多，炉膛越旺，出锭越快。兽皮要靠战士带回家。

dynamic.english: Straw dummies to strike -- the more you drill against them, the more each blow teaches. The catch from the shore keeps the yard, never the fight itself.
dynamic.chinese: 供你击打的稻草人——练得越多，每一击学到的越多。训练场靠海边的渔获维持，而非战斗本身。

dynamic.english: Picks laid out on leather, a chest left open to practise on: the surer the hand, the quicker the lift.
dynamic.chinese: 皮垫上摆着一排开锁针，还有一只敞开的箱子供你练手：手越稳，下手越快。

dynamic.english: A stone range fed with split logs: the hotter it draws, the faster the pot comes to the boil.
dynamic.chinese: 烧劈柴的石灶：火越旺，锅开得越快。

dynamic.english: Whetstones and a rack of bows in the making: keen tools, quick arrows.
dynamic.chinese: 磨刀石和一架还没完工的弓：工具锋利，箭矢就快。

dynamic.english: Bundles drying overhead on racks strung with sinew, a mortar on the bench: the fuller the rack, the faster the brew.
dynamic.chinese: 头顶的筋绳架上晾着一捆捆草药，桌上放着研钵：架子越满，酿得越快。

dynamic.english: A loom strung with sinew from the catch: the finer the thread, the quicker the work.
dynamic.chinese: 用猎物的筋穿线的织布机：线越细，活越快。

dynamic.english: A lectern of cut stone and a book that glows: the more is written, the surer a charm takes -- every level lifts the odds of an enhance landing by a percent of themselves.
dynamic.chinese: 石雕书台上摆着一本发光的书：写得越多，附魔越稳——每级让强化成功率按自身提高百分之一。

dynamic.english: A post bound in hide to strike at, notched by every blade that trained on it: the arm schooled here lands heavier blows.
dynamic.chinese: 裹着兽皮的木桩，布满了每把练过的刀留下的刻痕：在这里练出的手臂，出手更重。

dynamic.english: A suit on a wooden stand to drill against: every guard you learn on it counts for more in the field.
dynamic.chinese: 木架上挂着一套盔甲供你对练：在这里学会的每一招格挡，到了战场上都更管用。

dynamic.english: A straw butt on a stout wooden post: the eye trained here drives every arrow home harder.
dynamic.chinese: 结实木桩上的草靶：在这里练出的眼力，让每一箭都射得更狠。

dynamic.english: A stone altar with candles kept lit: the mind focused here casts with more force.
dynamic.chinese: 烛火长明的石祭坛：在这里凝聚的心神，施法更有力。

dynamic.english: Coins on a little shrine and a four-leaf clover pressed under glass: fortune, everywhere you look for it. Half a lift a level -- it reaches every skill.
dynamic.chinese: 小神龛上摆着硬币，玻璃下压着一片四叶草：无论在哪儿寻找，好运都在。每级提升一半——对所有技能生效。

dynamic.english: Shelves and crates: one more shelf in Storage for every two levels.
dynamic.chinese: 货架和木箱：每两级，仓库多一个货架。
所有技能获得更多经验。

dynamic.english: Mine, fish, chop, farm and steal faster.
dynamic.chinese: 采矿、钓鱼、伐木、耕种和偷窃更快。

dynamic.english: Smith, cook, fletch, brew and craft faster.
dynamic.chinese: 锻造、烹饪、制弓、酿药和工艺更快。

dynamic.english: Bank more progress while you are away.
dynamic.chinese: 离线时能积攒更多进度。

dynamic.english: Walk between rocks, trees and foes faster.
dynamic.chinese: 在矿石、树木和敌人之间走得更快。
所有战斗方式都打得更狠。

dynamic.english: Better odds of a rarer drop.

dynamic.chinese: 强化装备时成功率更高。

dynamic.english: Burn and stall-catch chance 3% lower, of the chance itself (20% becomes 19.4%)
dynamic.chinese: 烧焦率与偷窃被抓几率按比例降低 3%（20% 变为 19.4%）

dynamic.english: the fountain heals a tick sooner
0.5% faster at every gathering and crafting job
